# Site Signal fixture — full content dump

This file exists so the AI-readiness scanner finds /llms-full.txt at 200 and
does not report the llms-full minor. It mirrors the fixture pages in plain
Markdown, following the llmstxt.org convention of one H1, a summary blockquote,
and H2 sections of links.

## Home

The fixture home is the healthy reference page: complete metadata, an
organization entity, question headings with concise answers, and enough
server-rendered prose that no content check can flag it.

## About

The fixture exists so scanner tests run offline and deterministically. A live
site changes under you; a fixed copy served from a local directory is the only
fair reference.

## FAQ

Every question heading on the FAQ page is followed by a direct answer of
twenty to eighty words, which is exactly the shape the AEO checks look for.

## Content pages

The learning resource carries LearningResource JSON-LD with an author and a
dateModified; the plain page omits article schema on purpose so the suite can
assert both the credit and the deduction.

## Thin page

The thin page keeps its server-rendered text under eighty words so the
AI-readiness scanner reports the ssr-content critical check as its only
deduction, pinning the B grade boundary at exactly seventy-five.
